## About

Shubham Rao is a Senior Software Engineer at Lyric.tech (Core/Platform team), previously at Tune AI (NimbleBox.ai). Expertise in:

- **Languages**: Go (4+ years), Python (5+ years), TypeScript, SQL
- **Backend**: gRPC, Protocol Buffers, RESTful APIs, FastAPI, Apache APISIX
- **Infrastructure**: Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP, Kafka, RabbitMQ
- **Observability**: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, structured logging

## Experience

- **Senior Software Engineer** at Lyric.tech (2025–Present): Core backend team, TypeScript, system architecture
- **Software Engineer** at Tune AI (2020–2025): Built 100M+ token/day serving systems, OpenTelemetry adoption, document processing pipelines
